versions.content: The “Diagnostic Power Mode” byte of diagnostic power mode information response message contains the 1 Byte value retrieved by a call to the configured DoIPPowerModeCallback (for the signature see <User>DoIPGetPowerModeStatus, SWS_DoIP_00047 ). If the fun ction returns E_OK, the “Diagnostic Power Mode” shall be set to the retrieved value of PowerStateReady, otherwise it shall be set to 0x00 to indicate that the power mode is not ready.
